meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Telegram 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Telegram 频道消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Telegram channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Telegram channel messaging to your application

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你把 Telegram 机器人接入项目，自动复制适配器文件、安装依赖、注册通道，并指导你完成配对流程。
howto.when: 当你需要为项目添加 Telegram 机器人通道，或运行 `/setup` 流程时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Telegram 通道到项目。
say.note: Claude 会执行安装步骤并提示你创建机器人。

say.text: 运行配对步骤，把当前聊天注册为 Telegram 通道。
say.note: Claude 会生成配对码并指导你发送。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you integrate a Telegram bot into your project by copying adapter files, installing dependencies, registering the channel, and guiding you through the pairing process.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to add a Telegram channel to your project or when running the `/setup` flow.

say_en.text: Add a Telegram channel to the project.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the installation steps and prompt you to create a bot.

say_en.text: Run the pairing step to register this chat as a Telegram channel.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a pairing code and guide you to send it.
